NIGHT OPS

Four-wheeler hide & seek after dark on the real farm. Pick a side. Everyone on this link is in the same woods — no codes, no lobby.
HIDER Run dark, collect the three fuel cans, extract at the north field. His beam touches you and you're out instantly.
SEEKER Headlights and night vision. Anything your beam touches is out on contact. Hunt them all down.
KUBOTA Slow, wide eyes, can't tag anybody. Park dark on a gate and call out what you see. [SPACE] to radio a contact.
HONDA RANCHER Green. Lighter and quicker on its feet.
HONDA FOREMAN Yellow. Heavier, more grunt down low.
